posts.title: Bicyclist struck, killed in Lower Ninth Ward, NOPD says
posts.description: A man was killed in a traffic crash in the Lower Ninth Ward on the night of Friday, Nov. 27, according to the New Orleans Police Department.

posts.title: 17-year-old boy hospitalized following Mid-City shooting, NOPD reports
posts.description: A 17-year-old boy was injured in a Mid-City shooting that occurred on the evening of Friday, Nov. 27, police reported.

posts.title: Dillard University appoints interim leader after president steps down
posts.description: Dillard University's president has stepped down from her position, according to a statement from the institution.
